name: Can Euclid's lemma be proved formally using the coprime_iff_linear_combination theorem?

insights: coprime_iff_linear_combination converts gcd=1 to Bezout linear combination - the right bridge for Euclids lemma
The witness x*c + y*k is explicit and deterministic from Bezout coefficients and divisibility assumption b*c = a*k
linear_combination y*hk - c*hbez closes the algebra in one tactic call (ring identity: y*(b*c-a*k) - c*(a*x+b*y-1) = 0)
Working in Z (integers) avoids natural number subtraction issues with negative Bezout coefficients
IsCoprime in Lean 4 is definitionally exists u v, u*a+v*b=1 - the exact Bezout condition
